attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his newsletter, in his own voice.

semantics.note: 'Will only improve in connection to' reads as a firm claim that incredible earnings are a necessary condition. The 'only if' wording captures this. It states no horizon.

contract.note: Reading earnings as a necessary condition, and reading 'improvement' as meaningful spread tightening across the relevant borrowers (mainly neoclouds and developers, per the context), is ordinary and fair. 'Incredible' and the borrower scope are interpretive.

evidence.note: CNBC reports AI credit fears eased 'a little', driven by Meta's missing bond deal. This is mostly hyperscaler CDS, and spreads are still wide year to date. It does not show meaningful improvement across neocloud borrowers, so the contradiction condition is not met.
Company notice setting CoreWeave's Q3 call for Nov 10, after the evaluation date. Timing only.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm necessity forecast with no deadline. CoreWeave has not reported yet. The only sign of easing is modest, mostly in hyperscaler CDS, and tied to bond supply. It does not establish meaningful improvement across the relevant AI infrastructure borrowers without strong earnings. The packet itself says there is no comparable neocloud spread series. Nothing settles the claim.

attribution.note: Zitron's own summary sentence in his newsletter.

semantics.note: The two-step majority scope and the value-creation claim are kept. Naming the industry as AI follows from the context. Dropping 'in a period of poor value creation' is minor.

contract.note: Using dollars, global Q3 2026 for concentration, and the S&P comparison from the context is an ordinary reading. The LLM-related boundary and 'economic worth' are interpretive.

evidence.note: Crunchbase, primary data: $102B, or 64%, of global Q3 2026 venture funding went to AI. This supports the first majority only.
Derivative restatement of the Crunchbase 64% figure. It is not an independent check and adds nothing on LLMs or returns.
US-only, year-to-date fundraising figure of 71% in AI. Wrong geography and period, so it cannot settle the global claim.

reviews.rationale: Only the first part holds: more than half of global Q3 2026 venture dollars went to AI. The packet does not establish the share of AI funding going to LLM-related firms, those firms' lack of proven returns, or the since-2015 value-creation comparison with the S&P 500. No component is contradicted, but the combined claim is not settled.

attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his newsletter.

semantics.note: A firm 'will require' necessity claim. The proposition drops 'let alone continue growing' and 'without fail', but the core requirement is kept. 'In perpetuity' makes full support practically impossible.

contract.note: The literal sentence says 'every company involved', so a per-company reading is defensible. A group-level hyperbolic reading is also plausible, and the contract flags this. The period for the dollar threshold and the accounting basis are unspecified.

evidence.note: AMD's pre-publication guidance of about $13B in Q3 revenue. It is not a realized post-publication result and shows nothing about sustained valuation, so it cannot serve as the counterexample.

reviews.rationale: No deadline was given, and the packet has no post-publication valuation or financial record. Nothing shows a named company keeping its valuation while failing both the spending and revenue tests. The only item is pre-publication company guidance. The claim is neither supported nor contradicted.

semantics.note: A firm 'will' conditional with its antecedent kept. Reading demand as hyperscaler and neocloud buying follows from the paragraph. 'Suffer badly' fairly renders 'brutal knock-on effect'.

contract.note: Requiring the demand trigger first and then judging each named supplier separately is a fair, ordinary reading of the sentence.

evidence.note: Broadcom CEO says AI compute demand keeps growing. This is a company's statement about itself and does not establish whether demand wavered.

reviews.rationale: Nothing in the packet shows the antecedent, a demand downturn, has happened, so the conditional is not scored. There is no deadline, and no revenue or stock sequence after a downturn. It stays unresolved.
